name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面 GUI：Electron + WSL2 + 内嵌 dsh 运行时
author: DSH Desktop

scripts.start: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron .
scripts.start:dev: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron . --dev
scripts.smoke: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.js
scripts.dist: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:portable: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable
